How the quiz picks gifts

Suggestions come from a catalog we research by hand on retailer and manufacturer pages. The quiz filters by your budget and their interests, then varies the kinds of gifts it shows. Commission rates do not affect the order. Each suggestion names the detail to check before you buy, such as size, edition, or gaming system. More about how we choose
